first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A child with neck-length short brown hair, a red long-sleeved top, and dark blue overalls, riding Vehicle A with their back to the camera.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The low-profile vehicle ridden by Person A, with a visible blue high backrest, red low frame, two wide black rear wheels, and part of a metal handlebar.

entities.name: carpet
entities.identification: The carpet in the corridor, with a repeating geometric pattern composed of thick orange zigzags, dark brown areas, and red center blocks.

entities.name: lobby floor
entities.identification: The flat, reflective brown floor adjoining the carpet in the lobby on the left.

entities.name: corridor wall
entities.identification: The light beige walls, vertical wall corners, and dark baseboards in the corridor and near the lobby opening.

entities.name: interior door
entities.identification: The dark brown end door at the end of the corridor and the nearly black paneled door on the left revealed later in the clip.

entities.name: ceiling
entities.identification: The light-colored ceiling above the corridor, with transverse beam surfaces and edge molding.

entities.name: interior ceiling light
entities.identification: The ceiling light beneath the corridor ceiling, with a white circular shade and a bright bottom surface.

entities.name: lobby seat
entities.identification: The set of lobby seats in the background; at frame 50, a brown upholstered armchair partially out of frame at the left edge can be distinguished.

entities.name: potted green plant
entities.identification: The set of upright green potted plants on both sides of the end door and in the lobby on the left, distinguished by their visible positions.

entities.name: lobby wall lamp
entities.identification: The wall lamp in the upper left at frame 50, with a dark vertical base, slender lamp arms, and two warm-white glowing lamp heads.

entities.name: interior framed picture
entities.identification: The light-colored rectangular framed picture below the wall lamp on the left at frame 50, with a narrow frame and a blurry dark image in the center.
